    n0 == end ==> n7{{service}}
    n2[["alpha test queue test check retry gamma retry beta service service to test naïve"]] --- n0
    n11[(check gamma Ωmega start Ωmega deploy naïve Ωmega beta)] --x n9[\to test beta gamma deploy login ship error end\]
    n7 === n1@{ shape: hex, label: "标签" }
    n1 ==>|and| n4
    subgraph s1 [check]
      direction BT
      n10 x--x n0
      n8 <--> n7
      n3 -- check --> n3
      n2 === n9
      subgraph s2 [inner db]
        n7 -.-> n7
      end
    end
    n3{<bgamma of<b} -.- n11
    n2 o--o n5(["日本語"])
    n10[(review über of)] x--x n1
    n1 -->|build| n7
    n11 --x n8
    n4 ==> n1
    s1 --> n5
    classDef hot fill:#f66,color:#fff,font-weight:bold
    class n3,n0,n4 hot
